Re: Meeting with USAID
[contact omitted] Joshua Machleder Friday, April 16, 2021 at 11:28:53 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Mike Bradow
Hey Mike -- thanks so much for taking the time out to chat with our team. It was very informative and helped folks better
understand the processes and types of work you are doing in the field. I think having this more structured discussion and
us, getting our acts together in terms of how we more intentionally work on this problem set, and engage with platforms, I
hope, will be a net good. We will get back to you soon with a draft document to help us clarify the areas where we think
USAID can be engaging.
Best, Josh
On Fri, Apr 9, 2021 at 10:03 AM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Great - mostly a familiar crew!
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, April 8, 2021 6:00 PM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting with USAID
Thanks, Mike: I'm not sure if all of these people will be able to make it, but invitees will include:
Diana Parzik -- Disinfo Coordinator
Shannon Maguire -- E&E Bureau
Adam Kaplan -- OTI
Amy Maless -- OTI
Kevin Gash & Nicole Goodrich / Asia Bureau
Lisa Poggiali/Africa Bureau
Michael McNulty
Stephanie Molina / LAC
Milad Abraham / ME Bureau
Tristan Willman / CPS Bureau
On Thu, Apr 8, 2021 at 5:26 PM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Time sounds great - thanks Josh! Next week can you give me a heads up on participants?
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, April 8, 2021 2:03 PM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting with USAID
Thanks Mike --
Totally understand that this will likely be a very preliminary discussion. Even a better understanding of the different
teams working on different problem sets would be a great start, and that could be followed up on potentially. And of
course, talking through how Facebook prefers to engage with USAID or its partners, would definitely enrich
understanding on our end.
If the timing works for you,l'll put something on the calendar for Thursday, April 15 at 3pm.
Josh
On Thu, Apr 8, 2021 at 11:57 AM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,
So sorry for the delay - this one got lost in my Monday morning shuffle.

I'd be happy to join an informal discussion to help identify potential connection points, having in mind
that while I cover misinformation policy I'm not best placed to represent the work of other teams
specializing in coordinated inauthentic behavior, information operations, and hate speech. Perhaps
we can do this initial chat and identify potential follow-ups, including bringing in our stakeholder
engagement team for more formal engagement.
As for timing, I can do late afternoons on the 15th and 16th (after 3pm) if that works.
Look forward to it!
Mike
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Sunday, April 4, 2021 9:52 PM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Meeting with USAID
Hi Mike,
I hope you're doing well! Your colleagues here miss working with you.
USAID is forming a more coherent approach to its work in the information space, particularly around the issue of
disinformation and hate speech online, including forming a task team that includes representatives from DRG, from
our new Conflict Bureau as well as Regional Bureaus (and potentially later on from Global Health).
We were hoping that you might be available to talk with us to help us think through the most productive ways
USAID should engage with Facebook on these issues. Would you have some time to speak with us around April
15 or 16th?
Thanks!
Best,
Josh
Josh Machleder (he / him/ his)
Senior Media and Internet Freedom Advisor
USAID | Center of Excellence on Democracy, Human Rights and Governance
